Key Points

  • Interested in Freshworks Inc.? Here are five stocks we like better.

  • Freshworks is targeting enterprise growth by offering enterprise-grade employee experience software that is easier to deploy and manage, with less complexity and potentially lower costs than larger competitors.

  • The company is expanding beyond IT ticketing into enterprise service management, asset management and IT operations, while integrating acquisitions such as Device42 and FireHydrant into a unified platform. AI features, including Freddy Copilot and AI Agent Studio, are becoming central to product evaluations and customer adoption.

  • Freshworks reported $664 million in net cash, no meaningful debt and an expected $265 million in free cash flow this year. Management plans to pursue selective acquisitions and buybacks while targeting $1.4 billion in annual recurring revenue and $1.3 billion in revenue over the long term.

  • CRM Stocks Are Hot in 2024 — Should You Hold for 2025 Gains?

Freshworks (NASDAQ:FRSH) CFO Tyler Sloat said the company is positioning its employee experience, or EX, portfolio around enterprise-grade technology designed to avoid the complexity typically associated with larger software platforms.

Speaking during a company webinar, Sloat said Freshworks faces competition in virtually every deal and that its primary differentiator is delivering products that are easy to use, deploy and manage while still providing enterprise capabilities. He said the company's roots serving small and midsize businesses helped establish that emphasis on usability.

→ Lumentum Just Delivered the AI Growth Investors Wanted

  • Freshworks Stock Soars 50% – Is This the Perfect Entry Point?

"Our right to win really comes with… being able to deliver an enterprise-grade product without that enterprise-grade complexity," Sloat said, adding that the approach can also help customers reduce costs relative to competitors.

EX portfolio expands beyond IT ticketing

Sloat said Freshworks has broadened its EX offering from core IT service management, or ITSM, ticketing into several adjacent product areas. Those include enterprise service management, or ESM, IT asset management, or ITAM, and IT operations management, or ITOM.

→ Joby's Defense Pivot Accelerates With $500M Resonant Sciences Deal

  • Top 2 CRM Stocks Positioned to Surge Higher With AI in 2025

The company's ESM capabilities are intended to support business functions outside IT, with human resources representing the largest current use case, according to Sloat. He said Freshworks rearchitected its database layer to create separate workspaces with security and compliance controls, allowing functions such as HR to operate separately from IT teams.

  • 该公司正在将 IT 票务业务扩展到企业服务管理、资产管理和 IT 运营，同时将收购的 Device42 和 FireHydrant 等整合到一个统一平台中。 包括 Freddy Copilot 和 AI Agent Studio 在内的 AI 功能正在成为产品评估和客户采用的核心。
  • Freshworks 报告称，今年净现金为 6.64 亿美元，没有有意义的债务，预计自由现金流为 2.65 亿美元。 管理层计划进行选择性收购和回购，同时目标是实现 14 亿美元的年度经常性收入和 13 亿美元的长期收入。

Freshworks（纳斯达克股票代码：FRSH）首席财务官泰勒·斯洛特（Tyler Sloat）表示，该公司正在围绕企业级技术定位其员工体验（EX）产品组合，旨在避免通常与大型软件平台相关的复杂性。

斯洛特在公司网络研讨会上发表讲话时表示，Freshworks 几乎在每笔交易中都面临着竞争，其主要区别在于提供易于使用、部署和管理的产品，同时仍提供企业功能。 他表示，该公司的根基是为中小型企业服务，这有助于确立对可用性的重视。

“我们获胜的权利确实来自...... 能够在没有企业级复杂性的情况下提供企业级产品，”斯洛特说，并补充说，该方法还可以帮助客户相对于竞争对手降低成本。

EX 产品组合扩展到 IT 票务之外

Sloat 表示，Freshworks 已将其 EX 产品范围从核心 IT 服务管理 (ITSM)、票务扩展到多个相邻产品领域。 其中包括企业服务管理 (ESM)、IT 资产管理 (ITAM) 和 IT 运营管理 (ITOM)。

Sloat 表示，该公司的 ESM 功能旨在支持 IT 之外的业务功能，其中人力资源代表了当前最大的用例。 他表示，Freshworks 重新构建了其数据库层，以创建具有安全性和合规性控制的独立工作空间，从而允许人力资源等职能与 IT 团队分开运作。
